articles.title: Crypto wallet provider Ledger puts U.S. IPO plans on hold due to market conditions
articles.snippet: The French crypto security firm, which is said to have explored a potential $4 billion U.S. listing, is reassessing its public market plans as volatile conditions weigh on investor appetite for crypto IPOs.
